title: 第9654章 中央帝域第9653章 愣头青
content_zh:
“当然!如果没有阁下，即便我们也出手，配合灵老一起出手，估摸着也要生死搏杀，但因为阁下，我们沾了大光，这算是一次恩情。”
冉少燕立刻开口。
“请问阁下，在中央帝域是否有相熟的势力或者人?”
叶无缺轻轻摇头。
“暂时没有，不过这一次去了，或许就会有。”
这个回答再度让冉少燕心中一喜，她赶忙说道:“阁下，相逢即是有缘!更何况，我们还欠阁下一次恩情，于情于理，都应该回报给阁下。”
“所以，如果阁下不嫌弃的话，小女愿意做阁下进入中央帝域后的向导。”
“不管阁下有任何的要求和想法，小女都能帮忙。”
冉少燕说出了自己的想法。
闻言，坐着的叶无缺看着冉少燕，却是露出了一抹似笑非笑之意。
“你这是……想要招揽我?”
“但可惜，我一个人独来独往惯了，不喜欢被束缚。”
冉少燕没想到眼前的叶无缺这里竟然一下子就戳破了她的小心思，心中也是波澜起伏。
尤其是叶无缺的后半句话直接更是态度鲜明的拒绝了!
这让冉少燕心中产生了一丝挫败感，但她毕竟出身不凡，此番动力满满的出来，带着雄心壮志要历练自己。
万事开头难!
不要想着一口吃成一个胖子!
当无法一下子达到心中期盼的那个目标时，那么就需要先忍耐的退而求其次，将目标拆分，分布解决，反而可以峰回路转。
冉少燕脑海之中回忆起自己曾经接受过的栽培教育，瞬间就冷静了下来，脸上洋溢了一丝笑意。
“阁下言重了!”

“小女明白，阁下这样的存在，可不是三言两语就能打动的了的。”
“所以小女绝对不会擅自不切实际的胡想，请阁下见谅和放心。”
“不过还是那句话，阁下既然想要进入中央帝域，那么如果有一个熟悉中央帝域的人或者势力鞍前马后的话，可以省下很多的功夫和时间。”
“还请阁下给小女这个机会，毕竟小女等人欠阁下一次恩情，必须回报，否则的话，小女心中也会一直记挂。”
话语间，冉少燕再度对着叶无缺抱拳一礼，风姿绰约的脸庞上带着真诚。
托腮端坐着的叶无缺看起来依旧面色平静，但心中倒也轻轻一笑。
这个冉少燕虽然很稚嫩，但足够聪明，极短时间内的这番应答已经算得上诚恳与相对周到，一看就是接受过类似的教导。
理论知识满满，此番刚开始实践，临场发挥也还行。
当然!
冉少燕能够从叶无缺身上看到和想到的一切讯息，都是叶无缺想要给她看，故意暴露给她的。
“呵呵。”
“你这番话说的倒也诚恳，而且不得不承认，你说的也有一定道理。”
只听见叶无缺的声音再度响起，已经带上了一丝认同的笑意。
冉少燕心中顿时一振!
“不过你刚才说可以满足我一个要求，这是真的么?”
“当然!阁下尽请开口!”
听到叶无缺的话后，冉少燕反而心中更加的振奋了。
因为最怕的就是无欲无求，若是能投其所好，不管是什么要求，都是一个良好的开始。
叶无缺等的自然就是冉少燕这句话。
“我个人对于特殊的天地环境有些偏爱，这么多年来除了闭关外，也都在各处游历。”
content_en:
"Of course! Without you, even if we take action and cooperate with Elder Ling, we will probably have to fight to the death. But because of you, we have gained a lot of glory. This can be regarded as a favor."
Ran Shaoyan spoke immediately.
"Excuse me, your Excellency, are there any familiar forces or people in the Central Imperial Territory?"
Ye Wuque shook his head gently.
"Not yet, but if I go this time, maybe there will be."
This answer once again made Ran Shaoyan feel happy, and she hurriedly said: "Your Excellency, we are destined to meet each other! What's more, we owe you a favor, and we should repay you both emotionally and rationally."
"So, if you don't mind, my little girl is willing to be your guide when you enter the Central Imperial Territory."
"No matter what requests or ideas you have, I can help you."
Ran Shaoyan expressed her thoughts.
Hearing this, Ye Wuque, who was sitting, looked at Ran Shaoyan, but he showed a hint of a smile but not a smile.
"Are you... trying to recruit me?"
"But unfortunately, I'm used to being alone and don't like to be restrained."
Ran Shaoyan didn't expect that Ye Wuque in front of her would suddenly expose her little thoughts, and her heart was filled with ups and downs.
Especially the second half of Ye Wuque's sentence was a clear rejection!
This gave Ran Shaoyan a sense of frustration, but she had an extraordinary background after all, and she came out full of motivation and ambition to test herself.
Everything is difficult at the beginning!
Don’t think about becoming a fat man with one bite!
When you cannot achieve the goal you are hoping for at once, you need to be patient and settle for the next best thing. Split the goal and distribute it to solve it. On the contrary, you can turn things around.
Ran Shaoyan recalled the cultivation and education she had received in her mind, and instantly calmed down, with a smile on her face.
"Your Excellency is serious!"
"My little girl understands that a person like you cannot be impressed by just a few words."
"So my little girl will never have unrealistic dreams without authorization. Please forgive me and rest assured."
"But again, since you want to enter the Central Imperial Territory, you can save a lot of effort and time if you have someone who is familiar with the Central Imperial Territory or a force that is in charge."
"Please give me this opportunity. After all, I owe you a favor and must repay it. Otherwise, I will always remember you."
As he spoke, Ran Shaoyan once again raised his fist and saluted Ye Wuque, with sincerity on his graceful face.
Ye Wuque, who was sitting with his chin propped up, still looked calm, but he was smiling softly in his heart.
Although this Ran Shaoyan is very immature, he is smart enough. His response in a very short period of time can be considered sincere and relatively thoughtful. It seems that he has received similar teachings.
I am full of theoretical knowledge, but I have just started to practice this time, and my ability to perform on the spot is pretty good.
Of course!
All the information that Ran Shaoyan could see and think of from Ye Wuque was what Ye Wuque wanted to show her and deliberately exposed to her.
"Haha."
"What you said is quite sincere, and I have to admit that there is some truth in what you said."
Ye Wuque's voice was heard again, with a smile of recognition.
Ran Shaoyan's heart suddenly shook!
"But you just said that you can satisfy one of my requirements. Is this true?"
"Of course! Your Excellency, please speak up!"
After hearing Ye Wuque's words, Ran Shaoyan felt even more excited.
Because the most fearful thing is to have no desires and no demands. If you can give in to what you like, no matter what the request is, it is a good start.
Ye Wuque was naturally waiting for Ran Shaoyan's words.
"I personally have a preference for special worlds and environments. Over the years, in addition to retreating, I have also traveled everywhere."
